name: fetch_filing_item
description: Extract a specific Item section from a 10-K or 10-Q filing. Common items: "1" Business, "1A" Risk Factors, "3" Legal Proceedings, "7" MD&A, "7A" Quantitative and Qualitative Market Risk, "8" Financial Statements. Read-only.

accession.description: SEC accession number with dashes, e.g. "0000320193-25-000079". Get this from fetch_filings.

item_id.description: Item identifier per SEC form. "7" for MD&A, "1A" for Risk Factors, "3" for Legal Proceedings, etc.
